# Lancaster EPrints

> An institutional digital repository for Lancaster University research outputs, organized by year, subject classification, and academic divisions.

Lancaster EPrints is the official open-access research repository for Lancaster University, hosting peer-reviewed articles, research papers, and scholarly works across multiple disciplines. The repository uses Library of Congress Classification for subject organization and enables discovery through chronological, departmental, and subject-based browsing interfaces.

## Key Topics

## Browse & Discover

- [Browse by Year](http://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/view/year): Chronological browse interface for Lancaster EPrints repository
- [Browse by Subject](http://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/view/subjects): Subject classification browse using Library of Congress taxonomy
- [Browse by Department and Year](http://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/view/divisions): Browse Lancaster University departments and faculties by year

## Featured Research

- [HELP or HELP to: What do corpora have to say?](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/51): Corpus linguistics study on English help infinitive by McEnery & Xiao
- [Elliptical and discontinuous if-conditionals](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/771): Corpus linguistics analysis of conditional clauses using BNC data
- [Fusicoccin activates pathogen-responsive gene expression...](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/306): Plant pathogen resistance research on Pseudomonas syringae in tomato
- [Bioethics and large-scale biobanking](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/770): Bioethics analysis of individualistic ethics in biobanking projects
- [Magnetic biomonitoring of roadside tree leaves](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/291): Environmental monitoring of vehicle-derived particulates in urban dust

## Environmental & Earth Sciences

- [Evidence against dust-mediated control of glacial-interglacial changes](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/300): Paleoclimate research on atmospheric CO2 and dust iron fertilization
- [Monitoring unsaturated flow and transport using geophysical methods](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/475): Geophysical monitoring of subsurface water flow and tracer transport
- [Relationships between Spectral Reflectance and Pigment Concentrations](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/430): Remote sensing study of spectral reflectance in deciduous leaves
- [Hydrodynamics of model Posidonia oceanica patches in shallow water](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/361): Oceanography research on seagrass hydrodynamics and turbulence
- [Maximising the benefits from work-based learning](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/379): Environmental audits effectiveness study for geography education

## Technology & Physical Sciences

- [Forward Look on Nanoelectronics and nanotechnologies](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/582): European research strategy on nanoelectronics and ICT devices
- [Anomalous magnetoresistance of magnetic multilayers](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/581): Condensed matter physics study of magnetoresistance in superlattices

## Social Sciences & Critical Theory

- [Between Positivism and Post-modernity?](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/147): Critical criminology article on Jock Young's The Exclusive Society
- [Putting Hegemony in Its Place](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/181): Critical realism analysis of hegemony and state theory by Jessop
